story_title: Lina and Adams and the Big Feelings
title: Lina and Adams and the Big Feelings 🚲 | Learn Feelings in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Adams learns to ride his new bike in the park, and Lina and Adams learn about big feelings! 🚲🌇💛
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: excited, scared, brave, proud, angry, calm, tired and feelings. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🤩 excited — متحمس / فرحان بزاف — excité / impatient
😨 scared — خائف / خايف — avoir peur
🦁 brave — شجاع — courageux
🏅 proud — فخور — fier
😠 angry — غاضب / معصّب — en colère
😌 calm — هادئ / هادي — calme
🥱 tired — متعب / عيّان — fatigué
💛 feelings — المشاعر — les sentiments

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: ask your child "How do you feel today?" and help them name the feeling in English. Take three slow breaths together to feel calm. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصة باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم أسماء المشاعر بطريقة لطيفة.
🇫🇷 Une histoire en anglais pour enfants pour apprendre à nommer ses émotions.

lines.text: It is a warm evening. The sky is orange and pink.
Lina, look! I have a new bike! And a new helmet too!
Wow, Adams! Let's go to the park!
Adams jumps up and down. He can't wait to ride his bike!
When you feel very, very happy about something, you feel excited.
Say it with me: excited!
I am so excited!
At the park, Adams puts on his helmet. Click!
He looks at his bike. His tummy feels wobbly.
Lina, I never rode a bike before. What if I fall?
Oh, Adams. Are you scared?
When you think something bad can happen, you feel scared.
Can you say it? Scared!
It is okay to feel scared. I will help you.
I will hold the back of your bike. You hold the handles.
Okay. Don't let go yet!
I am right here. You can do it!
Adams sits on the bike. He puts his feet on the pedals.
Push, push. The bike rolls slowly. Lina walks next to him.
Wobble, wobble! Oh! I am riding!
Look ahead, Adams. Keep going!
Adams takes a big breath.
Lina, you can let go now. I want to try by myself.
Lina lets go. Adams pedals, and pedals, all by himself!
He was scared, but he tried anyway. Adams is brave!
When you do something even when you feel scared, you are brave.
Say it with me: brave!
Whee! I am doing it!
Adams stops his bike carefully and jumps off.
Lina! I did it! I rode my bike!
Hooray! You did it, Adams! Give me five!
Adams smiles a big, big smile. He feels proud.
When you feel good because you did something hard, you feel proud.
Can you say it? Proud!
I am proud of you too, Adams!
Lina has a yellow balloon. She holds the string.
Whoosh! A big wind blows. The balloon flies away!
No! My balloon! That is not fair!
Lina stamps her feet. Her face is red. Grr!
When something goes wrong and you feel hot and grumpy inside, you feel angry.
Say it with me: angry!
Oh, Lina. I am sorry about your balloon.
Lina, let's breathe together, like smelling a flower.
Breathe in slowly, smell the flower. Breathe out slowly, blow the candle.
One more time. In. And out.
Oh. I feel better now. My body is soft and slow.
When your body is quiet and peaceful, you feel calm.
Can you say it? Calm!
Thank you, Adams. Being angry is okay. Now I am calm.
Just then, Milo the cat comes walking across the grass. Meow!
Milo! Did you come to see me ride my bike?
Milo pushes a little red ball with his paw.
Look, Milo found a ball. Let's play together!
Lina throws the ball. Adams catches it. Milo runs after it!
Lina laughs. She forgets all about the balloon.
Friends make everything better!
Now the sun is gone. The sky is dark blue.
The first little star is shining up high. Twinkle, twinkle.
It is getting late. Let's walk home.
Adams, you push your bike. I will carry Milo.
Milo snuggles in Lina's arms. Purr, purr.
They walk slowly, side by side.
What a busy day!
On the street, Adams yawns. Yaaawn!
My legs are so heavy. I rode my bike so much!
My eyes want to close too. Yaaawn!
When your body needs rest and sleep, you feel tired.
Say it with me: tired!
Milo is tired too. He is already sleeping in Lina's arms.
Shh. Let's go home and rest.
At home, Lina and Adams sit on the bed. The lamp is warm and soft.
Today I felt so many things!
Happy, sad, angry, calm. Those are all feelings.
Feelings are what we feel inside, like happy, scared or proud.
All feelings are okay. We can talk about them with someone we love.
Can you say it? Feelings!
How do you feel now, Lina?
I feel calm and happy, because you are my friend.
I was excited, then scared, then brave, and then proud!
And I was angry, but then I felt calm.
And now everyone feels tired. Yaaawn!
Milo curls up on the soft blanket. Purr, purr.
Good night, Adams. Good night, Milo.
Good night, friends. Sweet dreams!
